title: Model of Sikhara
brief_description: Stone model representing the Shikhara, the tower or superstructure of a Hindu temple.
detailed_description: This artifact is a stone model of a Shikhara, the prominent tower that rises above the sanctum (Garbhagriha) of a Hindu temple. Characterized by its stepped architectural form and finely carved details, the Shikhara symbolizes the sacred Mount Meru, representing the connection between the earthly and the divine. Such architectural models illustrate the construction techniques and decorative styles employed by temple builders during the Kadamba period in Goa. The artifact reflects the region's rich architectural heritage and provides valuable insight into the evolution of medieval Hindu temple architecture.
